facts.fact: Health Minister Mduduzi Matsebula commissioned four mobile TB trucks, three equipped with chest X-ray and computer-aided detection AI, for the National TB Control Programme's screening, to be deployed to the regions.
facts.system: Mobile TB trucks with CAD/AI chest X-ray

facts.fact: The health minister said one of the CAD/AI trucks screened 229 people at the Eswatini International Trade Fair and identified eight cases referred to health facilities.
